notes.title: 1.6.0 - New Game Mode "Bobs Pancake Challenge"
notes.content:
New Game Mode
This game mode is all about your Upgrades!
Fight endless waves of slimes and see how far you can go.

Increase your stats in the Upgrade menu and use Flapjack Fury to your advantage to survive as long as possible and score high on the leaderboard.

The Leaderboard is accessible through the challenge overlay in-game

Changes & Bug Fixes

 DLC characters are now shown as unlocked characters in the main menu
 fixed auto-target weapons to no longer shoot in the upper right corner, when no enemies or too many enemies are in range

notes.title: 1.3.2.4: Leaderboard Hotfix
notes.content:
found an issue with Leaderboards correctly initializing on game launch, which prevented scores to be uploaded to the Steam Leaderboards. 
and another issue where Time to Clear for the Boss Rush was overwritten if the "Upload
Leaderboards Scores" button was used.

Both issues have now been fixed. Please be sure to be on the latest version (1.3.2.4) before you manually push your scores to the Steam Leaderboards via the Settings menu.

notes.content:

notes.title: A brand new bullet hell level awaits!
notes.content:
Snowflake found a secret path through the village. Are you up for the challenge?

This new game mode features a true bullet hell experience with everyone's favourite dog - Snowflake!

The rules here are a bit different compared to the standard levels:

 Pancake only
 No "auto aim", bullets always fire towards the right
 Unlimited pick ups to increase amount of pancakes thrown, increase pancake throw speed and lower heir cooldown
 your damage scales with your Upgrades. Level up Speed, Health, Vortex, Damage and Plot Armor. Each upgrade increases your damage by 0.1



This level is available right from the beginning, as an alternative progression path to the graveyard, which is more focussed on the bullet heaven aspect of the game. But be warned! Without any upgrades it'll be very hard!

notes.title: 1.2.3 Buff to Bella's Special and Bugfixes
notes.content:
New:


 Every character special is unique and good for different game modes, yet Bellas special was the only one which was totally useless in boss fights. This changes now, as it now can block projectiles, acting as a static shield


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658788/43f7ea70c41061e46c7ecfb2b720badc923f7b4d.gif


Bugfixes & changes:


 exp gems are now collected gradually over a time window of 2 seconds and not all at once to prevent a huge amount of exp gems causing a lag spike when all are collected at the same time. 
 fixed a bug, where collecting multiple magnets at once could set the collection radius to 99999 for the whole run
 boss HP now properly scales with difficulty settings. before some bosses had their multiplier applied twice and exponentially
 higher difficulty now grant higher scores. they did before, but since time is a score factor and higher difficulties take longer, this negatively impacted higher difficulties too much
 Goolop's Goo is despawning later now, if it does not hit an enemy

notes.title: 1.2.2.2 fixed knockback behaviour
notes.content:
changed Marsha's and Whysies HP pool.
 fixed a knockback issue. Mostly relevant for Goolops' Goo and the Maple Syrup Tornado. Thank you Kiffaz for pointing it out! Details about the problem and fix here: Steam Forum > Pancake Patrol > General Discussions
 fixed a sound bug on the Level 1 elite enemies, where it did not loop properly and created parts without music

notes.title: v1.2.2 Bob buffed & small bugfixes
notes.content:
Bob works well as a starting character because of his balanced stats. To make him more useful in the long run and differentiate him more, mostly from Harry, the following changes have been made:


 Bob +15%HP
 Harry -15% HP


Both changes also reflect the synergy with their respective special skill

other adjustments and fixes:


 stationary witches in Level 3 will now become targetable for auto-aim attacks after 90 seconds. previously they were ignored by those attacks.
 
 fixed an issue where enemy armor is persisting after a level, resulting in players dealing no damage on low levels or without upgrades
 fixed an issue where the tutorial screen was visible on the map screen after completion
 fixed an oversight, where the exp gem collection sound was set to "mute"
 fixed path texture in level 1 starting and ending abruptly
 fixed shadow on the Sakura Pillar attack
 fixed sakura pillar sprites overlapping each other if shooting left and right
 fixed a shader on Marsha's kit

notes.title: 1.2.1 small changes

added screen shake, particle explosion and sound effect to big Gift Boxes

notes.title: 1.2 Patchnotes | New Features, Bug Fixes, Balancing
notes.content:
Hi all! o/

Thank you all so much for your support of my first little game and all the feedback you are sending me!

Here are the patchnotes:

General Stuff:

 NEW Refresh Button on Level Up Screen
 It is now possible to refresh upgrades on level up three times. I might add rewards or drops to the maps which can increase this. Looking forward to your feedback
 NEW The Loading Screen features useful tips now
 Upgrade button now shows "Loading..." when clicked on it, to prevent the illusion of a lag
 Menu buttons are reacting faster to input
 Changed scary ghosts sound effect
 Better wording for coffee rush, so it's clear what it does
 Better contrast on witch duo's attacks
 NEW Right-click on a level to open and close the challenge panel in addition to [hover over a level] + [TAB]
 NEW Left-click to leave the challenge panel
 Screen Shake added for weapons with ground impact
 Gift Boxes now drop more stuff after getting P,L,I,N or S to unlock Bella


Balancing Changes:

 Level 1 Synergy weapons are now unlocked automatically if the required prerequisites are fullfilled.
 Horde Mode negative slots appear more often, the longer the player survives. these thresholds have been pushed back by 60 seconds
 Maple Syrup Tornados are slightly bigger now
 Changed Bob's Synergy weapon with Bella's
 The hidden exit now appears near the last cleared objective in Level 2


Bugfixes:

 Bob now correctly turns around when his special is active.
 Elite enemy drops now correctly drop apart from each other and not on top


Known Issues:

 [strike]Playing a level and then quitting the game from the main menu afterwards may lead to a crash. Issue is related to saving the file. I'm working on a fix.[/strike] FIXED

notes.content:

Horde Mode:

Boss Mode:

notes.title: PreRelease Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Features:

 Added the following Steam leaderboards:

 Horde Mode Time Survived (higher = better).
 Horde Mode Highscore (higher = better).
 Boss Rush Clear Time (lower = better).
 Boss Rush Highscore (higher = better).

 Leaderboards are currently only accessible through Steam.
 Added a button in the options menu to manually push leaderboard scores to Steam.
 Localized all achievements for all supported languages.
 Introduced more detailed shadows for players, elites, bosses, and enemies.
 Added an in-game settings menu, currently featuring only sound settings. Feel free to suggest additional options.
 Added synergy icons to the level-up screen to help players identify synergies between abilities more easily.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658788/8d75e048d10d821da2d0967760e3fd2a886aca15.png
 Improved collision detection for items to make them easier to pick up.
 Added a short invincibility frame after the level-up screen to prevent unavoidable damage.
 Added a guaranteed weapon upgrade option on the first level-up to reduce the impact of bad RNG.
 Removed irritating graphics on volume sliders.
 Added [space] as an alternative to [enter] for one-handed gaming.
 Added an indicator to the main menu that shows when a new boss fight is available in the "Boss Modes" menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658788/b2295acafaf1a1440442e0e7358bb8ed6dd2d517.png
 Added a scroll indicator to the [TAB] menu on the world map.


Balance Changes:

 Increased damage for all weapons at max level.
 Reduced Evelyn's HP by 64% (Level 1 Boss).
 Reduced Ruffles' HP by 23% (Level 3 Boss).
 Increased enemy damage across the board.
 Increased elite enemies' HP from the second spawn onward (Level 1).
 Increased enemy speed and defense after a specific threshold is reached or manually triggered (Level 2).
 Increased pickup area of weapons in Stage 4, to prevent starting the boss with no weapons equipped.
 Changed damage modifier difficulty setting.
 Slightly reduced the difficulty of Evelyn's bullet patterns (Normal version only; this change does not affect the Alternative and Beta versions).
 Increased coin rewards on higher difficulties.
 Lowered maximum coin costs for all upgrades.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed sound levels in level 1.
 Fixed a bug where achievements (in-game and Steam), which should only trigger on completing a level, are triggered on the player's death.
 Fixed an issue where mouse and keyboard/controller controls could highlight multiple upgrades on level up, making it unclear which one was picked.
 Fixed an issue where enemies became untargetable after the number of enemies on screen exceeded 500.
 Fixed graphic issues on musical notes, musical tornado, and musical wave.
 Fixed an issue where the window was always on top.
 Fixed in-game live score display to properly include character-specific multipliers.
 Fixed overlapping text on the level-up screen caused by the introduction of the new "synergy" information.

notes.title: Development Update Summer 2024
notes.content:
Hi there!

the last months have been very stressful and I only made slow progress, unfortunately.
Nevertheless, I'm almost finished! Blobking was one of the missing bosses, which is now complete, which only leaves the final boss to work on, Growl. After that it's a lot of polishing and implementing Steam API stuff, like achievements and leaderboard.

How hard can that be, right? 

I'm still aiming for a September '24 release, but if this will change, I'll have you informed end of this month.

Thank you for your ongoing support!

notes.title: Development Update March 2024
notes.content:
March has ended a while ago and I made a lot of progress!
The UI got a complete overhaul and is now a lot prettier and intuitive. I completed the base versions for all stages and almost all bosses, only the final boss is missing now and I've started to tackle the sound effect and music design.

notes.title: Development Update February 2024
notes.content:
Hello Pancake, Bullet Heaven and Bullet Hell Fans!

The month of February is over and I made heaps of progress with Pancake Patrol!
I'm almost finished with the default game mode's levels and halfway through the initial line up of boss fights and I'm confident I can wrap up 100% of the base content in March. After that I'll have a lot of polishing and balancing to do.

Once this is done, I'll focus on preparing the Demo for the Steam Next Fest in June

notes.title: Development Update February 2024
notes.content:
Hello Pancake, Bullet Heaven and Hell Fans!

Today I just want to give you all a quick update about the progress of Pancake Patrol.
It's going really well, I've almost completed the new UI, which is a lot more beautiful than before and slowly but surely everything is coming together and looking better and better every day!

I also began to simplify the UI overall as it was too fragmented, so the DPS Dummy moved to Options, Variety Modes were moved to the new Map screen, simply titled "Play" and everything boss related is unified under "Boss Menu"

Here is an example of the new Boss Modes menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658788/934542933404c8c703d6b7ece60d2e5dfed18491.png

As for gameplay content, I've finished Levels 1-3, the Horde Mode, 4 out of 10 boss fights, DPS Dummy and the Harry 1v1 fight. 
There is still a lot of work to do, but I'm confident that nothing stands in the way of a release in summer 2024.
